newsitem.title: USA: WINSTAR GETS INDIANA CLEC CERTIFICATION.
newsitem.headline: WINSTAR GETS INDIANA CLEC CERTIFICATION.

text.p: Winstar Communications Inc said Monday it had been authorized by the state of Indiana to provide competitive local exchange carrier (CLEC) services.
Winstar, in a news release, said the certification authorizes it to provide local voice, video, and data services in competition with the incumbent local exchange carriers.
WinStar said it now has CLEC certification in 24 jurisdictions, representing 38 major markets.
